output.reason: [ev-7be235e771a3] only says that support for the ACME profiles extension was added. It links to the IETF draft and PR #7777 but names no configuration surface, such as an Issuer/ClusterIssuer field, Helm value, flag or feature gate, that turns the feature on. It also gives no condition under which the new behaviour applies. Without that, there is nothing to write an applicability predicate against. The PR or the ACME issuer docs that describe the new field and how it is used are needed.
